results.name: Cheapest compares unlimited vendor and AH prices; explicit overrides still win
Missing timestamps and invalid prices are ignored; stale Auctionator data is excluded
A newer database refresh invalidates route and shopping estimates and refreshes visible guide
One three-point orange craft crosses a yellow boundary and reaches 103
Multi-point recipes cannot hand off at an unreachable intermediate skill
Yellow craft count integrates declining chances and remaining count is recalculated
A price for one limited-stock item cannot price an unquoted larger batch at zero
Shared limited vendor stock is checked for the combined route, not reused per step
Duplicate raw inputs from separate conversions use the aggregate purchase quote
Owned inputs reduce spending once and do not turn full-cost profit into free profit
Scan covers live-only recipes, transitive conversion inputs and money-making outputs
Margins use all materials, training once, minimum yield and selected auction cut
Unknown or invalid output quantities never become a fabricated profit opportunity
Guided unknown prices are subtotal-labelled and invalid reagent counts cannot enter a route
Allocated step costs sum to the aggregate route when limited vendor stock runs out
Returning to a previously trained recipe does not charge its fee twice

scope: Actual production Lua 5.1 with deterministic independent numeric fixtures; no live transactions
